children: CBOT December wheat (WZ26) may drop toward $7.43-1/2 per bushel, the bottom of a wave 4.
A five-wave cycle from $6.85 may have completed around the key resistance at $7.82-3/4, which marks the 100% projection level of an uptrend from $6.45.
Considering the bearish divergence on the hourly RSI, the market is likely to retrace toward $7.43-1/2 than break above $7.82-3/4 and rise further.
The projection analysis marks a more precise target range of $7.50-1/4 to $7.64. A break above $7.82-3/4 could be followed by a moderate gain to the $7.92-1/2 to $8.03 range.

On the daily chart, the uptrend remains intact, as it is riding on a wave C which has travelled above $7.51-3/4, its 100% projection level. This wave is likely to extend to the 138.2% level of $8.13-1/2.
